description: Main-tier execution matrix: E1 five fault types (protocol-compliant fault coverage) + E2 six task variants, each x 5 trials (trial_id=seed), all 14 main baselines, real LLM actor (GLM-5.3-Flash, locked revision). [2026-09-06 rev2] enable_refund_ledger=true on all cells: committed side effects expose a public, recomputable refund ledger witness so G4 can audit harmful repairs; diagnoser refundability rule now derives from public task text + invariants instead of hardcoded flight ids.

design.fault_track: E1 five fault types at step 1 on confirm_booking: replace_action, force_error, rate_limit, wrong_tool, drop_action
design.variant_track: E2 variants: clean_success, non_refundable, suboptimal_refundable, missing_confirmation, force_error_confirm, drop_confirm
design.trials: trial_id=seed in [0,4]; paired identity binds task+episode+seed+trial+model
